function.name: export_vault_file
function.description: Copies a vault file, or an earlier version of it, to toPath on your machine, replacing a file there. An artifact is written as its .artifact file, a zip holding its files and manifest that uploads back as the same artifact; with unpack it is written as a folder of its files at toPath instead, which must not exist yet or be an empty folder. Files up to 512 MiB.

surfaceId.description: The vault Surface's ID, from list_surfaces. Must satisfy the required format.

path.description: The file or artifact in the vault. Must satisfy the required format.

toPath.description: Where to write it on your machine

unpack.description: Write an artifact as a folder of its files rather than its .artifact file
